title: Newmark Advises IRA Capital on Recapitalization of Two Surgical Hospital Assets in Southeastern U.S.
summary: Newmark announces the Company has completed the recapitalization of a two-property surgical hospital portfolio in Florida and Louisiana on behalf of IRA…
body_markdown:
**October 29, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has completed the recapitalization of a two-property surgical hospital portfolio in Florida and Louisiana on behalf of IRA Capital.


Newmark Vice Chairmen and Co-Heads of[Healthcare Capital Markets](https://www.nmrk.com/services/investor-solutions/capital-markets/healthcare-capital-markets)[Justin Shepherd](https://www.nmrk.com/people/justin-shepherd) ,[Ben Appel](https://www.nmrk.com/people/ben-appel) , and[Jay Miele](https://www.nmrk.com/people/jay-miele) , Vice Chairman and Head of Healthcare Debt Capital Markets[John Nero](https://www.nmrk.com/people/john-p-nero) , Senior Managing Director[Michael Greeley](https://www.nmrk.com/people/michael-greeley) , Associate Directors[Ron Ott](https://www.nmrk.com/people/ron-ott) ,[Conor Hilton](https://www.nmrk.com/people/conor-hilton) and[Drew Martin](https://www.nmrk.com/people/drew-martin) served as the exclusive financial advisor to IRA Capital, which will remain invested in the portfolio alongside a new institutional capital partner. The limited partner was not disclosed.


The portfolio, totaling 170,661 square feet, comprises Naples Surgical Hospital in Naples, Florida, and Central Louisiana Surgical Hospital in Alexandria, Louisiana. Both assets are fully occupied by leading healthcare operators.


“IRA Capital has built an institutional-quality healthcare real estate portfolio focused on properties that play a critical role in healthcare delivery,” said Shepherd. “This recapitalization attracted significant interest from institutional investors due to the quality of the assets, their locations within established healthcare campuses and the strength of the underlying operators. The transaction provides IRA Capital with a new long-term partner while positioning the firm to continue expanding its best-in-class healthcare real estate footprint throughout the United States.”


The transaction represents the latest milestone in Newmark’s longstanding relationship with IRA Capital. The Newmark Healthcare Capital Markets & Investment Banking team has advised on nearly $2 billion in aggregate gross asset value transactions involving IRA Capital in recent years including acquisitions, dispositions and recapitalizations.


Naples Surgical Hospital is an 87,030-square-foot surgical hospital located in Naples, Florida. Situated adjacent to a major hospital campus, the facility serves as an important component of the region’s healthcare infrastructure and provides a range of surgical and specialty care services.


Central Louisiana Surgical Hospital is an 83,631-square-foot surgical hospital in Alexandria, Louisiana. The property supports advanced surgical care and specialty medical services and serves patients throughout Central Louisiana.
